explanation: Each technique targets one bottleneck: idle batch slots (continuous batching), repeated prompt work (prefix caching), latency when decode is far from compute-bound (speculative decoding uses the idle compute to check several tokens per step), long prefills interleaving with decodes (chunking), bytes of weights (quantisation), and interference between the two phases (disaggregation). Tokenizer efficiency is real but is a model choice, not a serving technique.
